tracking: ADR-0359 (lane E40): API-only behaviour baseline routes, awaiting the screens on #453

gaps.GET /v1/behaviour/settings: reads the behaviour baseline mode (shadow by default), its limits and the sweep state
gaps.PUT /v1/behaviour/settings: turns behaviour baselines off (step-up, audited as a relaxation) or back on in shadow mode (audited)
gaps.GET /v1/behaviour/findings: pages behaviour anomaly findings, newest first, filtered by status, subject or signal
gaps.GET /v1/behaviour/findings/:findingId: one behaviour finding with its baseline, deviation and allowed next states
gaps.PUT /v1/behaviour/findings/:findingId/st: acknowledges or dismisses a behaviour finding (audited)
gaps.GET /v1/behaviour/baselines/:subjectKind: a user's or agent's current baseline per signal (median and MAD, or the usual keys and their shares)
